wu: Alphabet Relay: Students line up in two teams. Teacher calls out a letter (U-Z), first student runs to the board, writes it, runs back, tags next player. Team with all letters wins. They shout 'U, V, W, we are the best!'
wuAlt: Letter Jump: Teacher holds flashcards U-Z, students jump when they hear their letter's sound
Alphabet Chain: One student says 'U', next says 'V', continue until Z
pres: Teacher displays flashcards umbrella, violin, window, xylophone, yellow, zebra. Models 'U is for umbrella /ʌ/, V is for violin /v/' etc. Students repeat. Teacher asks 'What is it? It is a __.' Students answer. Checks understanding by holding up random cards.
presAlt: Storytime: Read 'The Umbrella and the Zebra' with U-Z words, point to letters as they appear
Mystery Box: Students reach in, pull out object (toy violin), say letter and sound
prac: Pair Picture Dictation: Student A has U-Z pictures, Student B has alphabet chart. A says 'Write umbrella under U', B writes word under correct letter. Swap roles. Teacher monitors and helps with spelling.
pracAlt: Alphabet Order Race: Teams get shuffled U-Z word cards, first to line them up alphabetically wins
Sound Match: Students match U-Z picture cards to sound cards on the board
ls: Alphabet Neighbors Game: Teacher plays a recording of mixed U-Z letter sounds. Students hold up two cards when they hear neighbors (e.g., V and W). Teacher checks pairs.
re: Alphabet Jump Rope: Students jump while chanting 'U, V, W, X, Y, Z', stop when teacher claps. Last one out does a silly dance.
prod: My Alphabet Chart: Students trace U-Z letters in a chart, then write 3 words under each (from flashcards). They share with partner 'This is umbrella, U-U-Umbrella!'
rw: Write in Order: Students write 5 U-Z words on slips, mix them, then reorder alphabetically. Copy sentences: 'Umbrella starts with U. Zebra starts with Z.'
st: Sing the Alphabet Song with actions (U: open arms like umbrella, Z: roar like zebra). Story: 'The Zebra's Umbrella' with U-Z focus. Goodbye routine: Goodbye Song + sticker chart + high-five line.
g: Students cover pictures when teacher calls out U-Z sounds
Teacher says 'Line up from U to Z!', students race to order themselves
Jump on correct letter when teacher says sound
Find U-Z words hidden in classroom, say letter and sound
Students say 'I spy with my little eye, something beginning with U'
diff: Fast finishers: Write a sentence with 2 U-Z words and draw a picture
Support: Trace letters with dotted lines, use word bank for spelling
hw: Write 3 sentences: 'U is for umbrella. V is for violin. Z is for zebra.' Draw pictures
Make flashcards for U-Z words with pictures and sounds
Practice the alphabet song with family, teach them the actions
tip: Use Moroccan context: show pictures of 'umbrella' for sun protection, 'violin' in local music. Link to Green March by saying 'Z is for zero, like the start of our march!'
